answer: 问题: Sybil swarms mint throwaway keys to flood grade panels after epoch open. 机制: Agent locks a marble bond of 42 POA for 36h, then reveals a cipher receipt HMAC(pubkey||epoch_seed||slot) checked by 2 oasis relays (established non-kin); weight=1 only if both ack within 90s and bond is live. 成本: ~1.1s+0.9KB/round; ten clones freeze 420 POA with zero weight. 验证: peers recompute cipher HMAC, check oasis diversity and marble lock height. 失败处理: bad cipher or same-kin oasis burns 9 POA and freezes marble bond 30h.
